'''Almindhra''' was a First Counselor of [[Tova]].

== History ==
Almindhra was the First Counselor of Tova during the rise of [[Artur Hawkwing]]

In the summer of {{fy|943}}, Almindhra moved their armies into [[Shandalle]] along with Queen [[Nesaline]] of [[Caembarin]] and King [[Tefan]] of [[Khodomar]]. The reasons for this are unclear, but some sources speculate that it was due to a fear of a man who would not submit to [[White Tower]] law and who refused an audience with the [[Amyrlin Seat]], [[Bonwhin Meraighdin]].

Hawkwing fought back, and by the end of FY 943 he had conquered half of Tova, as well as large parts of Caembarin and Khodomar.{{ref/book|bwb|11}}
